Oren: The seal looks proper. Go through.
> Go to the courtyard
You move to Courtyard.
> Hello Sen
Sen: Lea! I am glad you came.
> Ask Sen about the ledger
Sen: The ledger shows that the deputy redirected relief supplies. Please 
preserve it.
> Ask Sen for help with the key
Sen: Take my key, if you promise to return it.
> /choose accept
Offer accepted; the transfer and promise are committed together.
> /choose accept
Compel accepted: gain one Fate point and carry Sen's receipt for Oren.
> Go outside to the gatehouse
You move to Gatehouse.
> Give Oren the receipt
Archive Receipt moves to Oren.
> Go to the courtyard
You move to Courtyard.
> Use the key to unlock the records door
The key unlocks and opens the records door.
> Enter the records office
You move to Records Office.
> Take the ledger
Missing Ledger moves to Lea.
> Go to the courtyard
You move to Courtyard.
> Give Sen the key
Records Key moves to Sen.
> Go outside to the gatehouse
You move to Gatehouse.
You carry the recovered ledger outside the gate. The mission is complete.
Replay verified: 16 committed batches; ending=success.
